summary: Jabil Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that the Board rejected conditional resignations tendered by directors John Plant and Tiger Tyagarajan after they failed to receive a majority vote at the 2026 annual meeting. The Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee evaluated each resignation, citing strong attendance records, engagement, and qualifications. The Board determined their continued service is in the best interests of the company. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation event.
